budget_rule: a row starts only if committed spend + its cap <= $250; if wave-2 headroom runs short, defer #39 first, then #74 (old records stay); pairs are never reduced to fit money (coordinator 07:57Z)
vcpu_rule: a fewer-GPU offer (alt_shapes) is sized by its vCPUs: est x (0.5 + 0.5 x max(1, vcpu_ref / vcpus)), vcpu_ref = 16 per GPU of the primary shape; the latest-start and cap rules apply to that estimate (coordinator 10:02Z)
balance_rule: a launch is refused when RunPod balance - live rows' caps - this row's cap - $7.55/h (sweep lane) to 18:00Z < $25 (the guard floor; coordinator 11:37Z)
